I am an economist working in applied microeconometrics, with experience building and validating datasets for policy-relevant empirical work. I am comfortable presenting results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

I am currently completing an MRes in Economics at [Sciences Po, Paris](https://www.sciencespo.fr/ecole-recherche/en.html), following a B.A. (Hons.) in Economics and Social Studies at [Trinity College Dublin](https://www.tcd.ie/).

## Research interests

- Political economy
- Housing markets and local governance
- Wealth and spatial inequality
- Tax-benefit policy and distributional analysis

## Contact

The best way to reach me is by email at [michellejord01@gmail.com](mailto:michellejord01@gmail.com).
